Co-main sees unified strawweight king Oscar Collazo (13-0, 10 KOs) defending his WBA/WBO/Ring belts against Jesus Haro (13-3). Don't miss Alexis Rocha vs. JoJo Diaz Jr. in a 10-round welterweight war, plus undisputed flyweight champ Gabriela Fundora (17-0) facing Viviana Ruiz Corredor in a 10-round title defense.
